



## Statistical inference

### NPSEM-IE
- Assumptions:
  - no interference
- Define whole population DAG 
- Missing observation indicator independent of covariates
- Non-parametric estimation of structural functions is feasible

### (Random) Network NPSEM-IE
- Assumptions:
  - homogenous network interference according to constant or random network
- Define whole population homogenous DAG 
- Missing observation indicator independent of covariates
- Non-parametric estimation of structural functions is infeasible
  - network exposure values are censored for each observation
- Need to model censoring mechanism considering random thinning of the network and underlying network topology

### Bipartite Network NPSEM-IE
- Assumptions:
  - homogenous network interference according to constant or random bipartite network
  - one partition of the random bipartite network is fully observed 
  - other partition has missing observation indicator independent of covariates
- Non-parametric estimation of structural functions is feasible
  - network exposure values are fully observed for each observation 
- Censoring mechanism is independent of network values
